Hud.FullAttackText: Attacks with {what}, one swing after another. Each swing opens the normal attack roll (Normal / Advantage / Disadvantage, or your own dice), and damage follows as usual.
Hud.FullAttackHint: Left-click: attack. Enter rolls Normal in each roll window; tick Quick on the bar above the HUD to roll the rest without windows. Right-click: pick another weapon. Esc on a roll pauses; Esc again stops. Clicking a weapon by hand still works and counts.
Hud.NoSwingsLeft: No swings left in your Attack action this turn. You can still click a weapon by hand if the GM allows it.
Hud.NewTurnHint: Out of combat there is no turn order: click to start a fresh turn (swings, Sneak Attack and follow-ups available again).
Hud.PoleStrikeGated: Pole Strike opens after you take the Attack action with a Quarterstaff, Spear or Heavy weapon with Reach.
Hud.WithNick: {weapon}, then {nick} as the free Nick attack

FollowUp.NoFocus: No Focus Points left for Flurry of Blows.

FollowUpText.offhand: The Light property's extra attack, as a Bonus Action. Your ability modifier isn't added to its damage unless it is negative (or you have Two-Weapon Fighting).
FollowUpText.nick: Nick: the Light extra attack made as part of the Attack action, so it costs no Bonus Action. Once per turn.
FollowUpText.flurry: Spend 1 Focus Point and make {n} Unarmed Strikes as a Bonus Action. Each strike opens its own attack roll.
FollowUpText.martial-arts: One Unarmed Strike as a Bonus Action.
FollowUpText.hew: Great Weapon Master: you scored a Critical Hit or dropped a creature to 0 HP — one more attack with the same weapon as a Bonus Action.
FollowUpText.pole-strike: Polearm Master: you took the Attack action with a Quarterstaff, Spear or Heavy weapon with Reach — one attack with its other end (1d4 Bludgeoning) as a Bonus Action.

Strip.Paused: Paused — the roll was closed. Resume, pick a new target or another weapon, or Stop (Esc).
Strip.AdvHint: For the next swing only. The roll dialog's own buttons work too.
Strip.QuickHint: After the first swing, roll the rest without the dialog (same Normal / Advantage / Disadvantage). Manual dice still ask for each roll.
Strip.StopHint: End the Full Attack here. With a roll window open, that roll still counts if you roll it, and no further window opens. Swings not taken stay available.
Strip.PickTarget: Target a creature for the next swing (Stop cancels).
Strip.AlreadyRunning: A Full Attack is already running — finish or stop it first.
Strip.NoWeapon: That weapon is no longer available.

PausedNote.main: Swings you don't take stay on your Action pips.
PausedNote.flurry: Your Focus Point is already spent: Resume to take the strikes it paid for.
PausedNote.bonus: Nothing is spent until you roll: your Bonus Action is still free.

Rule.sneak-attack: Once per turn, on a hit with a Finesse or Ranged weapon, if you have Advantage — or an ally who isn't Incapacitated is within 5 ft of the target — and you don't have Disadvantage.
Rule.frenzy: While raging, after Reckless Attack: extra d6s on the first Strength-based hit this turn.
Rule.colossus-slayer: Once per turn, on a hit against a creature that is missing any of its Hit Points.
Rule.divine-strike: Once per turn, on a weapon hit.

ToggleHint.ask: Ask (now): a '+ {name} {dice}' button appears on your attack cards; click it when the GM says you hit. Click to switch to Auto.
ToggleHint.auto: Auto (now): {dice} is added to the first eligible attack's damage this turn, with an Undo if it missed. Click to switch to Ask.

Rider.UndoHint: It missed: give back this turn's use (the GM just doesn't apply this damage).
Rider.Stale: That attack was on an earlier turn — use the button on this turn's attack card.
Rider.RecklessWhere: (turn it on from the Special bar)

fullAttack.Name: Full Attack button
fullAttack.Hint: A Full Attack button on the Argon Action bar for characters with 2+ attacks: every swing in a row, one roll dialog each. Off: no button; weapons work as before.

swingPips.Name: Swing pips
swingPips.Hint: The Action pips count swings (2 → 1 → 0) for characters with Extra Attack, also when weapons are clicked by hand. Off: one Action pip as before.

followUps.Name: Follow-up buttons
followUps.Hint: Off-hand, Nick, Flurry of Blows, Martial Arts and Hew appear as one-click buttons only when the character qualifies. Off: no extra buttons.

gateFollowUps.Name: Pole Strike only after attacking with a polearm
gateFollowUps.Hint: Polearm Master's Pole Strike shows on the Bonus bar only after the Attack action with a Quarterstaff, Spear or Heavy Reach weapon. Off: always shown.

riderOffers.Name: Sneak Attack and once-per-turn riders
riderOffers.Hint: '+ Sneak Attack 3d6' (and Frenzy, Colossus Slayer, Divine Strike) on attack cards, once per turn; each player can switch theirs to Auto. Off: use the feature items by hand.

weaponBonuses.Name: Two-Weapon Fighting and Great Weapon Master damage
weaponBonuses.Hint: Adds the ability modifier back to off-hand damage (Two-Weapon Fighting) and +Proficiency to Heavy weapon hits in the Attack action (Great Weapon Master). Off: add them by hand (don't also use GWM's separate damage button when this is on).

offhandModeReset.Name: Off-hand mode doesn't stick
offhandModeReset.Hint: After an off-hand attack the weapon's next attack defaults to its normal grip again. Off: dnd5e remembers Offhand.

offhandPip.Name: Off-hand spends the Bonus pip
offhandPip.Hint: An off-hand attack greys the Bonus Action pip, not the Action pip. Off: Argon's default.

seedWeaponSets.Name: Fill empty weapon sets
seedWeaponSets.Hint: Once, for characters whose Argon weapon sets were never set: set 1 = main melee weapon + Light off-hand, set 2 = ranged weapon. Never overwrites a set someone dragged.

multiattack.Name: Full Attack for Multiattack
multiattack.Hint: NPCs and Wild Shape forms get Full Attack from their Multiattack (e.g. Bite then Claw). Off: the Multiattack card as before.

recklessToggle.Name: Reckless Attack toggle
recklessToggle.Hint: A 'Reckless Attack: On/Off' button on the Special bar for Barbarians: it applies the Reckless effect (Advantage on Strength attacks until your next turn), which Frenzy's hint reads. Off: no button; apply Reckless by hand.

skipPickerGuide.Name: Skip Argon's Target Picker Tutorial
skipPickerGuide.Hint: Nobody gets Argon's one-time Target Picker Tutorial on their first attack (it cost a Confirm click mid-combat); instead the '0/1 Targets' label at the cursor says 'right-click cancels'. Off: the label is Argon's own; a browser that has not yet seen the tutorial sees it once.

specialActions.Name: Dash, Disengage, Dodge and Hide do what they say
specialActions.Hint: Argon's built-in action buttons spend your Action (and the swing pips); Dash adds your Speed for the turn; Disengage shows on you for the turn; Dodge ends at the start of your next turn; Hide rolls Stealth against DC 15 and keeps Hiding only on a success. Off: Argon posts its card and nothing else.

reactionSlot.Name: Opportunity Attack on the Reaction bar
reactionSlot.Hint: The weapon on the Reaction bar reads 'Opportunity Attack: <weapon>' and spends your Reaction, never one of your Attack action's swings. Off: Argon's plain weapon slot, which spends your Action on your own turn.

escRollDialog.Name: Esc closes a roll window
escRollDialog.Hint: Esc closes a dnd5e roll window straight away, without clicking into it first. Off: click the window, then Esc.

tidyCancelledAttacks.Name: Remove the card of a cancelled attack
tidyCancelledAttacks.Hint: If you close an attack's roll window without rolling, its empty use card is removed from chat (only when nothing was spent). Off: the card stays.

deathSaveDamage.Name: Damage at 0 HP is a death save failure
deathSaveDamage.Hint: A character who takes damage at 0 Hit Points gets a Death Saving Throw failure, two from a Critical Hit (PHB). Massive damage is whispered to the GM, never applied. Off: the GM edits the tally.

portraitConditions.Name: Conditions on the HUD portrait
portraitConditions.Hint: Prone, Poisoned, Grappled, Dodging and other conditions show on the Argon portrait, with the rules text on hover; right-click removes one as usual. Off: the portrait shows only effects with a duration.

hudFollows.Name: HUD follows your token
hudFollows.Hint: When your creature's turn starts, the HUD switches to it; clicking one token of a selected group switches the HUD to that token. Off: toggle Argon to switch.

clearTargetsAfterTurn.Name: Release targets when your turn ends
clearTargetsAfterTurn.Hint: Your targets are released when your turn ends, so your next attack never goes to last turn's creature by mistake. Off: targets stay until you change them.

dockRollDialogs.Name: Roll windows above the swing bar
dockRollDialogs.Hint: During a Full Attack or follow-up, each roll window (and the manual-dice window) sits just above the swing bar, at the same height every swing, and its title says which swing it is. The bar's Adv / Dis / Quick / Stop stay visible. Off: windows open in the middle of the screen.

scrollingTextGuard.Name: Background tab: no floating text, no chat pop-ups
scrollingTextGuard.Hint: A browser tab in the background skips the floating damage numbers and the chat-card pop-ups (nobody sees them; they piled up and logged core errors when the scene changed, a card was deleted or the tab came back). The chat tab's unread pip still lights. Off: core behaviour.

bonusPip.Name: Bonus-action features spend the Bonus pip
bonusPip.Hint: Rage, Steady Aim, Divine Smite, Lay on Hands, a Bonus-action spell: used on your turn, they grey the Bonus pip and close Off-hand / Flurry / Hew for the turn. Argon spent nothing for them. Off: Argon's default.

selfEffects.Name: Self effects switch on when used
selfEffects.Hint: A feature that only affects you and has one effect (Rage) switches that effect on when used, through dnd5e's own Apply. Off: click Apply on its chat card.

steadyAim.Name: Steady Aim sets up Advantage
steadyAim.Hint: Using Steady Aim adds a 'Steady Aim' effect: the next attack's roll window opens on Advantage and your Speed is 0; it is removed after that attack or at the end of your turn. Off: only the chat card; click Advantage yourself.

drawerNearButton.Name: Drawers open by their button
drawerNearButton.Hint: Argon's Use Feature / Cast Spell drawers open just above the button that opened them instead of at the HUD's far left. Off: Argon's position.

spellPips.Name: Spells spend their Action and Reaction pips
spellPips.Hint: Fire Bolt, Fireball or Magic used from the HUD greys the Action pip; Counterspell or Shield greys the Reaction pip (on any turn, back at the start of your turn). A re-bound HUD or a new round keeps the pips that were spent. Argon spent nothing for spells. Off: Argon's default.

quickenedSpell.Name: Quickened Spell makes the next spell a Bonus Action
quickenedSpell.Hint: After you use Quickened Spell on your turn, the next spell with a casting time of an Action spends the Bonus pip instead of the Action pip, so the Action stays free (for a cantrip). Off: Quickened Spell only spends its points.

helperTokenControl.Name: Your token comes back when a helper token goes
helperTokenControl.Hint: When an area handle you dragged, or a summon you had selected (Flaming Sphere), is deleted and nothing else is selected, your caster's token is selected again, so the HUD stays up. Off: nothing is selected and the HUD closes.

Hint.off: Off (now). Click when you make your first attack this turn: Advantage on Strength attack rolls until your next turn starts (the roll dialog then defaults to Advantage), and attacks against you have Advantage. Frenzy counts it.
Hint.on: On (now): Advantage on Strength attack rolls until your next turn starts; attacks against you have Advantage. Click to turn it off (a misclick).

Reckless.On: Reckless Attack: on until the start of your next turn.

Turn.NoActionLeft: You have already used your Action this turn. {action} was posted anyway; check with your GM.

EffectText.dash: Extra movement equal to your Speed for this turn (PHB: Dash). Ends at the end of your turn.
EffectText.disengage: Your movement doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks for the rest of this turn (PHB: Disengage). Ends at the end of your turn.

Turn.Hidden: Stealth {total} vs DC 15: you are hidden. Your total is the DC to find you.
Turn.HideCancelled: Hide cancelled: no Stealth roll, not hidden.
Turn.DeathFail: {name} takes damage at 0 Hit Points: a Death Saving Throw failure ({n} of 3).
Turn.DeathFailCrit: {name} takes a Critical Hit at 0 Hit Points: two Death Saving Throw failures ({n} of 3).
Turn.Massive: {name} took {amount} damage, at or over their Hit Point maximum ({max}). By the PHB (Massive Damage / Damage at 0 Hit Points) the character dies. Not applied: set their Death Saving Throw failures to 3 if you rule it so.
Turn.SteadyAimText: Advantage on your next attack roll this turn (the roll window opens on Advantage). Your Speed is 0 until the end of the turn. Ends after that attack, or at the end of your turn.
Turn.SteadyAimOn: Steady Aim: your next attack defaults to Advantage; Speed 0 this turn.
Turn.QuickenedCast: Quickened: {spell} is your Bonus Action. Your Action is still free.
